title.en: An Act to Amend Section One, Paragraph (Mm), of Act Numbered thirty-three Hundred and Forty-One, and to Extend the Reversion of Unexpended Balance of Fund Appropriated therein Up to December thirty-First, Nineteen Hundred and thirty-One.

text.en:
Section one, paragraph (mm), of Act Numbered Thirty-three hundred and forty-one is hereby
amended to read as follows:
"1. SPECIAL PROJECTS
(mm) For the construction and completion of the Manila post-office building, equipment, dock and grounds,
P2,500,000: Provided, That only the sum of P500,000 shall be available for disbursement during the year
1927: And provided, further, That the funds appropriated for the project may only be expended with the
approval of the Governor-General after the Secretary of Finance has certified that funds are available for the

The unexpended balance of appropriation under paragraph (mm), section one of Act Numbered
Thirty-three hundred and forty-one as above amended, is hereby made available for expenditure up to
December thirty-first, nineteen hundred and thirty-one, any provision of existing law to the contrary
notwithstanding.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, November 21, 1930.
